info.title: OpenAsy Knowledge Base API
info.summary: A public help center of articles by topic and language, suggested in the ticket form and the chat window.
info.description:
Every screen of Knowledge Base uses this API, and so can your scripts (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

The help center itself is plain HTML at `/help/` (or at the address the settings file gives it): `/<lang>/`, `/<lang>/topics/<slug>`, `/<lang>/articles/<slug>` and `/<lang>/search?q=`. The ticket form and the chat window load `/s/suggest.js`, which calls `/api/v1/suggest` as people type. Settings come from the settings file, never the API. Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

get.description: What the suggest script calls as people type in a ticket form or chat window; Helpdesk may call it from its servers too. Pages of the origins in suggest.sites (and the help center) may read the answer; searches from other origins are answered but not kept. With `sid`, the form's last words are kept as one search for the reports. Only published articles the reader may see are offered: plan-only ones need `reader`. `place=preview` is never kept. Up to 240 calls a minute from one address.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: The reader's language; the default one when it is not the help center's.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: A random id for the open form, 8 to 64 letters, digits, _ and -.

parameters.name: reader
parameters.description: A reader token, for customers who may read plan-only articles.

200.description: The articles, best first.

post.description: After suggestions: `ticket` when the form was sent anyway, `closed` when it was closed. Closed after opening an article counts as a question answered. Sent as text/plain so navigator.sendBeacon needs no preflight; JSON is taken too.

202.description: Taken; recorded is false when no kept search has that sid.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when Knowledge Base runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the Knowledge Base origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings, API tokens (`oa_knowledge-base_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when Knowledge Base is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

gaps.description: Different searches that found nothing in 30 days.

lang.description: One of the help center's languages; the default one when left out.

body.description: Markdown or HTML; sanitized before it is kept.

owner.description: A member's id; the one who writes it when left out.

translations.description: Words by language; null removes a language. New words take a published article back to draft, while readers keep the published ones.

lang.description: The language the articles are offered in.

search.description: The sid, when the search is kept for the reports.

url.description: The article on the help center, in the reader's language, with where it was suggested.

to.description: A help center path, such as /en/articles/export-the-ledger.
